figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of BridgeRouter. (A) Training. Paired EEG–target-modality data are used to train cross-modal bridges and the router, with the validation-selected pathway πa serving as the anchor. The router is supervised by the anchor-relative gain gik = NLLia −NLLik. (B) Inference. Given only the target modality, the router predicts the gains of alternative pathways and selects the best alternative when its predicted gain exceeds the protection threshold τ ; otherwise, it retains the anchor.
